properties.decision: Built as (a), PROPOSED, awaiting Anthony. In plain terms: an objection whose only support is evidence (a report, a study, a statistical test) is evidence against, not a counterexample. (a) It contests the claim it opposes and never refutes it, the rule statistical tests already follow (built: reports now share it). (b) A report the owner grades highly (source A, credibility 1) refutes; lower grades contest.
properties.name: Does an objection that rests on a report refute what it opposes, or only contest it?
properties.rationale: (a) extends the existing rule for statistical tests (req:a-hypothesis-tests-verdict-reads-as-supported-at-alpha-never-as-shown) to reports, and matches the capstone observer's expectation that rival assessments stay a dispute, not a one-way refutation. (b) would make a grade change a truth, which the requirement says a grade never does. Measured 2026-10-20: no reading in the trial designs changes by it — the capstone's U1 objections already contest, because each holds only under supposition S3 — so it decides what a design that cites a report alone against a claim will read.
